Title: The Great Gatsby
Description: The Great Gatsby is a classic American novel by F. Scott Fitzgerald that explores themes of decadence, idealism, resistance to change, social upheaval, and excess, creating a portrait of the Jazz Age or the Roaring Twenties in the United States.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

Description: 1984, written by George Orwell, is a dystopian novel that explores the dangers of totalitarianism, surveillance, and government control. The story is set in a future society where the government, led by Big Brother, constantly watches and manipulates its citizens.
Author: George Orwell

Title: To Kill a Mockingbird
Description: To Kill a Mockingbird, written by Harper Lee, is a classic novel that explores themes of racial injustice, morality, and the loss of innocence. Set in the 1930s South, it follows Scout Finch as she navigates the complexities of society and her father's legal defense of an innocent black man accused of raping a white woman.
Author: Harper Lee

Title: Moby-Dick
Description: Moby-Dick, written by Herman Melville, is the story of Captain Ahab's obsessive quest to kill Moby Dick, the giant white whale. It is a complex tale of revenge, obsession, and the sea, exploring themes of fate, free will, and the nature of evil.
Author: Herman Melville

Title: The Catcher in the Rye
Description: The Catcher in the Rye by J.D. Salinger is a coming-of-age novel that follows Holden Caulfield, a disillusioned teenager, as he struggles with the loss of innocence and the complexities of adulthood. Set in post-war New York, the novel touches on themes of alienation, mental health, and the challenges of growing up.
Author: J.D. Salinger

Title: Pride and Prejudice
Description: Pride and Prejudice, written by Jane Austen, is a romantic novel that explores the nature of love, marriage, and society. Set in rural England, it follows Elizabeth Bennet and her interactions with the aloof, wealthy Mr. Darcy.
Author: Jane Austen

Title: The Hobbit
Description: The Hobbit, written by J.R.R. Tolkien, is a fantasy novel that follows Bilbo Baggins as he embarks on an adventure to recover treasure guarded by the dragon Smaug. Along the way, he encounters trolls, elves, and goblins.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien

Title: The Odyssey
Description: The Odyssey, written by Homer, is an epic poem that chronicles the adventures of Odysseus as he journeys home from the Trojan War, encountering gods, monsters, and temptations along the way.
Author: Homer

Title: Brave New World
Description: Brave New World, written by Aldous Huxley, is a dystopian novel set in a futuristic society that has achieved apparent perfection through technology, mass production, and the suppression of individuality.
Author: Aldous Huxley

Title: War and Peace
Description: War and Peace, written by Leo Tolstoy, is a historical novel set against the backdrop of the Napoleonic Wars, focusing on the lives of Russian aristocrats as they navigate the challenges of love, family, and war.
Author: Leo Tolstoy

Title: Nature

Author: Various

Title: The Lancet

Title: Journal of Finance
Description: The Journal of Finance is a leading academic journal in the field of financial economics, focusing on a wide range of topics such as asset pricing, corporate finance, and market behavior.

Title: Science

Title: IEEE Transactions on Computers

Author: Various

Title: National Geographic
Description: National Geographic is a monthly periodical known for its stunning photography and deep coverage of science, geography, and exploration.
Author: Various

Title: TIME

Author: Various

Title: Vogue

Author: Various

Title: Forbes

Title: Thriller
Description: Thriller is Michael Jackson's iconic album, which includes hit songs like 'Billie Jean' and 'Beat It'. It is one of the best-selling albums of all time.
Author: Michael Jackson

Title: Back in Black
Description: Back in Black is AC/DC's landmark album, featuring hits like 'You Shook Me All Night Long' and 'Hells Bells'. It remains one of the best-selling albums in history.
Author: AC/DC

Title: Abbey Road
Description: Abbey Road, released by The Beatles in 1969, is considered one of the greatest albums of all time. It includes timeless tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.
Author: The Beatles

Title: Hotel California
Description: Hotel California by The Eagles is an iconic album that blends rock with country and features the famous title track, known for its intricate guitar solos.
Author: The Eagles

Title: The Dark Side of the Moon
Description: The Dark Side of the Moon by Pink Floyd is a groundbreaking concept album that explores themes of mental illness, greed, and the human condition.
Author: Pink Floyd

Title: The Shawshank Redemption
Description: The Shawshank Redemption tells the story of Andy Dufresne, a man wrongly imprisoned for the murder of his wife. It's a tale of hope, friendship, and the endurance of the human spirit.
Author: Frank Darabont

Title: The Godfather
Description: The Godfather is a crime drama about the powerful Corleone mafia family, exploring themes of power, loyalty, and revenge.
Author: Francis Ford Coppola

Title: The Dark Knight
Description: The Dark Knight, directed by Christopher Nolan, is a superhero film about Batman's efforts to stop the Joker from destroying Gotham City.
Author: Christopher Nolan

Title: Forrest Gump
Description: Forrest Gump tells the story of a man with a low IQ who leads an extraordinary life, witnessing and impacting key moments in American history.
Author: Robert Zemeckis

Title: Pulp Fiction
Description: Pulp Fiction, directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a crime drama with interconnected storylines that explore themes of redemption, fate, and violence.
Author: Quentin Tarantino

Title: The Last of Us
Description: The Last of Us is an action-adventure game that follows Joel and Ellie as they navigate a post-apocalyptic world, facing dangers from both infected creatures and hostile humans.
Author: Naughty Dog

Title: Minecraft
Description: Minecraft is a sandbox game where players can build and explore procedurally generated worlds, gathering resources, crafting tools, and surviving against hostile mobs.
Author: Mojang Studios

Title: Red Dead Redemption 2
Description: Red Dead Redemption 2 is an action-adventure game set in the late 1800s, where players control Arthur Morgan, a member of the Van der Linde gang, navigating a wild frontier.
Author: Rockstar Games

Title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
Description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world role-playing game where players control Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter, as he embarks on an epic journey.
Author: CD Projekt Red

Title: Fortnite
Description: Fortnite is an online multiplayer game where players battle to be the last one standing in a battle royale mode or build creative structures in a sandbox environment.
Author: Epic Games

Title: Cyberpunk 2077
Description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world RPG set in a dystopian future where players control V, a mercenary with customizable abilities, navigating the neon-lit streets of Night City.
Author: CD Projekt Red

Title: Grand Theft Auto V
Description: Grand Theft Auto V is an open-world action-adventure game that follows three criminals as they plan heists and engage in crime across the fictional city of Los Santos.

Description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare is a first-person shooter game that follows a covert team as they navigate global conflict in a realistic, gritty world.

Title: Overwatch
